name: ArchiveBox
description_en: 🗃 Open source self-hosted web archiving. Takes URLs/browser history/bookmarks/Pocket/Pinboard/etc., saves HTML, JS, PDFs, media, and more...
readme_excerpt: ArchiveBox Open-source self-hosted web archiving. ▶️ Quickstart | Demo | GitHub | Documentation | Info & Motivation | Community     ArchiveBox is a self-hosted app that lets you preserve content from websites in a variety of formats. We aim to make your data immediately useful, and kept in formats that other programs can read directly. As output, we save standard HTML, PNG, PDF, TXT, JSON, WARC, SQLite, all guaranteed to be readable for decades to come. ArchiveBox also has a CLI, REST…
